text: The design said --diff-root is ignored without a diff, but run_digest rejects it with exit 3 (alsem.rs:1811-1816; pinned by lone_diff_root_is_exit_3). So A3(a) could not pass, and A3(c)'s exit 3 came from the wrong check.
evidence: Root decision: the lone-check is gated on !reads_paths(), and its message names diff or file inputs. A routine-only or input-free --diff-root still exits 3, tested in A3(d). A3(c) asserts 'is not a folder'. The false sentence is gone.

text: P3 does not establish --changed-files support: DigestCli has no --changed-files flag.
evidence: Scope: the file inputs are --file and the --changed comma list. --changed-files is legacy wording in --changed's help (alsem.rs:689) and in the no-input error (:1820), filed as discovery D1, not added as a flag.

text: A ws:-prefixed file input (and the ws: candidates a user copies back from the diagnostic) would get the root-relative reading, so under an explicit root it would turn unmatched; strip_diff_prefix does not strip schemes.
evidence: File step: a scheme-prefixed input keeps exactly one reading under every root, normalize_input (today's key). The human hint offers 'pass one candidate as --file'. A2 and A3(a) test ws: inputs on ambiguous_ws and under --diff-root.

text: With --diff --diff-root R, a --file src/x.al that resolves today becomes file-unmatched: a behaviour change that needs a CHANGELOG Changed line and a test.
evidence: The 'Explicit --diff-root with files' section states the change, and CHANGELOG ### Changed lists it. A3(a) tests --diff-root with --file src/posting.al (unmatched), Cloud/src/posting.al (resolves) and ws:src/posting.al (resolves). Spec r2 (sol): A3(a) now also tests the mixed regression itself: --diff with --diff-root and --file src/posting.al gives the diff's roots plus file-unmatched, and with Cloud/src/posting.al gives both sets of roots.

text: --changed X is a diff whenever X exists relative to the cwd, so A1's --changed subcase depended on the test's working directory, and from the git top --changed Cloud/src/posting.al is read as diff text.
evidence: A1 uses a comma list that is no path and sets the child's current_dir. The cwd behaviour predates #339; it is a stated limit in the CHANGELOG and filed as discovery D2 with its own acceptance.

text: On ambiguous_ws, a --file that resolves today becomes file-ambiguous with exit 2; the 1.8.0 contract and the CHANGELOG must say the file side is not purely additive.
evidence: Schema: the 1.8.0 contract line lists #353 and #339 and says a path that resolved can now be file-ambiguous and give no roots. The CHANGELOG ### Changed says the same.

text: Boundary cases are untested through the new file-input path: absolute paths, ./ prefixes, exact-case prefix folders, case-normalized keys.
evidence: A1 adds ./Cloud/src/posting.al. A3(f) covers an absolute path to an existing file and wrong-case cloud/…, both file-unmatched. Stated limits name both, and absolute paths are discovery D3. Spec r2 (sol): A1 adds the positive case-normalization case, --file Cloud/SRC/POSTING.AL resolving identically.

text: Mixed file and diff behaviour was unspecified: a poisoned diff section next to a valid --file, the union without duplicates, and ambiguity alongside a resolving input.
evidence: File step: ambiguity gives no roots from THAT input; file and diff roots union by declaration; #72 poisoning covers diff-derived roots only. A2 adds an ambiguous file with a resolving --routine (exit 0). A3(e) adds a valid file with a poisoned diff section. Spec r2 (sol + opus N1): the resolving input is the owner-qualified --routine D8PostingChain::PostSalesDoc (a bare name is selector-ambiguous on ambiguous_ws), asserted as exit 0 with exactly that root and exactly one diagnostic. A3(e) adds a healthy file+diff run that unions without duplicates and has entries equal to the file-only run.

text: A2 did not pin file ambiguity independently of routines (table-only readings) or the exact candidate order.
evidence: The shared matcher counts workspace files, routines or not. A2 asserts the exact candidate order and adds a --file counterpart of table_only_reading_still_ambiguous. Spec r2 (sol): A2 adds two case-distinct files within one reading (src/posting.al and src/Posting.al, skipped with a note where the file system folds case), whose candidates keep their original spelling in sorted order.

text: A4 proved parent planning only; workers (multi-batch) also need a file-only parity case.
evidence: A4 adds a two-batch manifest: a file-only job in the worker batch, and a second worker job with an explicit --diff-root.

text: A1's oracle was weak ('contains PostSalesDoc'), and it had one mutation only, on reads_paths, not on the file step itself.
evidence: A1 asserts the posting file's exact routine list and equal entries, and has a second mutation: the file step uses normalize_input only.

text: The documentation inventory was incomplete: --file 'Workspace-relative' help, --changed and --diff-root help, and the decide_diff_root / ChangedInput.workspace_files / workspace_file_keys / DiffRoot / DigestRequest.diff_root docs.
evidence: The Docs list names each of these.

text: Adding one FileAmbiguous line to the human unit test proves presence, not that its file and candidates are escaped.
evidence: A5: the new case carries control and bidi characters in its file and in one candidate, and asserts the exact escaped line.

text: Candidates are sorted within a reading and kept in reading order, not sorted globally; the wording must say so.
evidence: The Shared matcher section says 'sorted and deduplicated within that reading, and concatenated in reading order … not sorted globally'.

text: prove passes workspace_files: &[]; a future caller with files would silently get every file unmatched. File-only batch jobs now record .git probes. workspace_file_keys could be built lazily.
evidence: 'Not changed' records the prove call and adds a doc note. The Root decision records the planning-read probe, as #77 does for diffs. The lazy build is not taken: one HashMap over the workspace files per call is cheap, and both steps use it.

text: Pre-existing gaps the review surfaced are out of scope: the legacy --changed-files wording, --changed's cwd-relative diff detection, and absolute paths.
evidence: Filed as discoveries D1, D2 and D3 in the ledger's ## Discoveries, each with a reproducer and an acceptance.

text: A2's mixed case would fail as written: --routine PostSalesDoc is selector-ambiguous on ambiguous_ws, because the renamed copy declares PostSalesDoc too.
evidence: A2 uses the owner-qualified --routine D8PostingChain::PostSalesDoc and asserts exit 0, exactly that root, and exactly one diagnostic (file-ambiguous). The reason is written next to it, so the implementer does not loosen the oracle.

text: A ws: candidate copied from file-ambiguous did not pick one file when the reading held case-distinct units: normalize_input lowercases, so ws:src/Posting.al rooted both src/Posting.al and src/posting.al.
evidence: 0903cd05: file_hits keeps only the spans whose source_unit_id equals ws: + clean_segments(rest), with case kept. A2's case-sensitive block asserts that each id roots exactly its own file's routines and anchors. Proof: dropping the exact filter makes ws:src/Posting.al root both files (4 entries). The doc and CHANGELOG say an id names one file exactly. Final r2 (sol re-raise): the fallback fired whenever the exact id had no routine spans, so a table-only src/Posting.al fell back and rooted src/posting.al. Fixed in e32970af (W11).

text: has_scheme read any input starting with ws: as a snapshot id, so a real folder named ws:Cloud (the #77 F1 case) became file-unmatched under --diff-root, while the same path in a diff resolves.
evidence: 0903cd05: an id whose exact reading names no unit falls back to match_path on the raw input. A new Unix-only test, ws_named_folder_resolves_under_diff_root, has a proof: without the fallback, no roots.

text: An app:<guid>:<path> input was called an id read as written, but strip_scheme drops the guid, so a dependency's id matched the workspace file with the same path.
evidence: 0903cd05: only ws: counts as an id for file inputs. app:<guid>: goes through match_path as before #339; that pre-existing strip is kept, not advertised. Help, docs and CHANGELOG no longer offer app: ids for --file.

text: workspace_file_keys was built on every call, even for routine-only runs.
evidence: 0903cd05: a LazyCell builds it the first time the file or diff step reads it, so a routine-only run never builds it.

text: has_scheme repeated strip_scheme's prefix parsing, so the two could drift.
evidence: 0903cd05: one ws_rest(p) -> Option<&str>. strip_scheme is ws_rest(p).or_else(app_rest).unwrap_or(p), and the file step uses ws_rest.

text: Proof row 1 said 'count of the original text 0', which reads like a scripted break that matched nothing.
evidence: The ledger row now states what was checked: the original text was gone (the break applied) and the test failed.

text: The --file help implied workspace-, git-top- and --diff-root-relative readings all apply together, and the --changed help added wording next to the nonexistent --changed-files.
evidence: 0903cd05: the --file help says that with --diff-root a path is read relative to that folder only. --changed says '.al entries → read like --file paths'.

text: Two doc comments were wrapped unevenly (the DiffRoot doc, and a roughly 100-column line in the decide_diff_root doc).
evidence: 0903cd05 rewraps both.

text: file_key/file_hits and diff_key are near copies that differ in their diagnostic constructors.
evidence: This shape was ratified: the Design's shared matcher, with sol's spec note 'keep path interpretation centralized and diagnostic-kind mapping at the callers'. match_path holds the one resolution rule. The two wrappers differ in more than the constructors: file_hits has the ws: exact-unit rule and the fallback, diff_key keeps its #77 signature. Merging them would put file-only policy into the diff path.

text: Help and errors still name the nonexistent --changed-files and --changed-routines.
evidence: Pre-existing and out of scope by the ratified Scope (V2). Filed as discovery D1, with the real flag names (--file, --routine) in its acceptance. #339 adds no new use of the names (W7).

text: W1's match_path fallback fired whenever the exact ws: id had no routine spans, so a table-only src/Posting.al next to a routine-bearing src/posting.al fell back and, in automatic mode, rooted the lowercase sibling.
evidence: e32970af: file_hits first checks whether a workspace file has the id's exact spelling (rel_posix after the same \→/ and clean_segments cleanup, case kept). If it does, the result is that file's exact spans, so a file with no routines is file-unmatched, with no fallback. Only when no file has that spelling does it fall back to match_path (W2). Test: A2's case block makes src/Posting.al table-only and expects exactly file-unmatched on ws:src/Posting.al, with no roots and exit 2. Proof: restoring the span-based fallback gives diagnostics []. The CHANGELOG line was also rewrapped (opus nit).
